result.summary: The page appears mostly functional with one notable visual issue identified.

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' card in the 'Fastest near you' section has a dark/black background that visually clashes with the other restaurant cards which have light backgrounds. This inconsistency makes it look like the restaurant image failed to load and is showing a fallback dark background instead.
issues.suggestion: Ensure restaurant thumbnail images load correctly and have consistent background styling. If the image is intentionally dark-themed, consider adding a subtle border or ensuring the card dimensions and style match the other cards in the row.
